April presentation page 90 describes acquired land adjacent to Kati 1, corroborating grouping but not proving a precise location.

new_locator_route.result: Full physical/printed page 89 contains a Kati 2 site schematic, not a georeferenced map. It labels an internal data center, utility yards, parking and stormwater areas, but no street name, physical address, parcel identifier, coordinates, CRS, north arrow or geographic tie point is supplied. Full page 90 states adjacent land acquisition without a locator. The drawing and accompanying image cannot be used to derive Kati 1 coordinates.

new_locator_route.rights: No open license asserted. Temporary source PDF and review renders are not redistributed. The tracked packet retains only compact factual analysis with source attribution; the plan, photographs and geographic-looking drawing are not copied into the atlas.

new_sec_identity_discovery.factual_summary: The credit agreement defines the Willacy County Kati project and related land lease, purchase and sublease transactions. Section 4.26 refers to a Schedule 4.26 containing physical data-center addresses. The address schedule was not located in the reader. These legal definitions are discovery context, not an exact parcel/address/coordinate claim and not selected organization roles.
new_sec_identity_discovery.scope_caveat: A required ALTA/NSPS survey and a reference to a 50-acre parcel do not publish that survey or locate its boundary. No coordinates are inferred from landowner or wind-farm names.
